activeControl.purpose: Separate provider control; never inserted into the MyJam customer report.
activeControl.identityBasis: The bounded identity probe returned one Page ID whose Page name overlaps the submitted brand and whose ad evidence points to the nike.com company domain; the exact task then discarded any non-matching Page IDs.
activeControl.deliveryDatePolicy: Provider fields are date-granularity values. Records whose stop calendar date precedes the observation calendar date are excluded; records dated through the observation date remain in the active-status result.

qualityGateIncident.finding: The provider returned a Halalo record with a 2025 delivery-stop date from an active-status task.
qualityGateIncident.resolution: Task 023 now excludes exact-Page records whose public stop calendar date predates the observation date and reports the excluded count. Version 36 reclassified Halalo from verified-active to no-verified-result with one stale record excluded.
